usedFor: Grist holds your records, and Google Contacts holds your address book, so “New Record” can run “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in Grist, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: A person added to a Grist table becomes a Google Contacts entry without copying details by hand.

watchOut: Use “New Record”, not “Updated Record”, with “Create Contact”, or edits could add the same person again.
